title: Catherine of Aragon and Anne Boleyn

instruction.text: Look at the image. What do you think Henry VIII is worried about?

feedback.finish: In Tudor times, most people didn’t think that girls should rule. Henry wanted a son to take his crown and become king after him!

atoms.b: Henry’s wife, Catherine of Aragon, was ((++pregnant perfumed)) six different times!
Unfortunately, only one of her children ((++survived sounded)) childbirth.
Her one surviving child was a ((++daughter son)), who would become Queen Mary I of England.

feedback.finish: Henry was very angry about not having a son with Catherine and blamed her for it.

instruction.text: Select the lady of the court.

feedback.finish: Henry had fallen in love with another lady at court, Anne Boleyn. But he couldn’t marry her while he still had a wife.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation between Henry VIII and the Pope.

hint.label: Pope
hint.text: The Pope is the leader of the Catholic Church. Catholicism was the main form of Christianity in Europe at the time, so what he said was a big deal!

atoms.b: I want to divorce my wife, but I need permission from you as the leader of the ((++Church farm)).
((++Divorce Dining)) is not allowed under Catholicism. You know that Henry.
If you don’t ((++allow annoy)) me, I’ll do it anyway.
Then I shall tell the people of England that you’re no true ((++Catholic character)).
In that case, I’ll just make a new Church. One where I make the ((++rules names))!
atoms.sound: ssml: In that case, I’ll just make a new Church. One where <emphasis level='strong'>I</emphasis> make the rules!

feedback.finish: Henry’s new church was called the Church of England. He changed the rules so that he could get divorced.

instruction.text: Build the portrait of Anne Boleyn.

feedback.end: Henry and Anne married in 1533, and Anne gave birth to a daughter, Elizabeth, in the same year.

feedback.finish: Henry and Anne were only married for three years before Anne was accused of plotting against the king and executed! These claims were almost certainly false.
